evidence: The Inland Track links Marahau to Wainui Bay via Pigeon Saddle on the Tākaka - Tōtaranui Road.
From Marahau follow the Coast Track to Tinline Bay.
At this saddle, the track forks and an easy 45-minute descent begins to the Wainui car park.

doubts: Start: the text names Marahau; F3 (where Coast Track meets Harvey Road) is taken as the Marahau start, about 1 km from the Mārahau place point, but the page names no road; this is a judgement. The Wainui car park has no feature the text clearly matches (F6 is well inland of Wainui Bay, F1 is the Taupo Point Track), so the end ref is null. Pigeon Saddle is walked (via T14) and also given as an access point at F2, the road-end feature on Totaranui Road at the saddle. The Canaan car park is taken as F7 (where Moa Park Track meets Canaan Road), but the text does not say which track it joins, so onto is null. Porter Rock side track: the text does not say where it leaves the way, so from is null. The water taxi is named in the round-trip sentence rather than as a way out, so the exit is a judgement. Holyoake Clearing and Moa Park Shelter are shelters with no bunks stated, so they are not listed as huts. DOC's '3 days' is copied; the section times add to about two days.
